import json, re

with open('/workspace/model/tokenizer.json') as f:
    tok = json.load(f)
added = {a['content']: a['id'] for a in tok['added_tokens']}
merges = {tuple(m if isinstance(m, list) else m.split(' ')): i for i, m in enumerate(tok['model']['merges'])}
def byte_to_unicode():
    bs = list(range(ord('!'), ord('~')+1))+list(range(ord('¡'), ord('¬')+1))+list(range(ord('®'), ord('ÿ')+1))
    cs = bs[:]; n = 0
    for b in range(2**8):
        if b not in bs: bs.append(b); cs.append(2**8+n); n += 1
    return dict(zip(bs, [chr(c) for c in cs]))
b2u = byte_to_unicode()
def bpe_word(word):
    chars = [b2u[b] for b in word.encode('utf-8')]
    while len(chars) > 1:
        pairs = [(merges.get((chars[i], chars[i+1]), 10**9), i) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
        r, idx = min(pairs)
        if r == 10**9: break
        chars = chars[:idx] + [chars[idx]+chars[idx+1]] + chars[idx+2:]
    return chars
pat = re.compile(r"(?i:'s|'t|'re|'ve|'m|'ll|'d)|[^\r\nA-Za-z0-9]?[A-Za-zÀ-ÿ]+|[0-9]| ?[^\sA-Za-z0-9À-ÿ]+[\r\n]*|\s*[\r\n]+|\s+(?!\S)|\s+")
def tokenize_chat(user, reply):
    full = f'<|im_start|>user\n{user}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n{reply}'
    out = []
    for p in re.split(r'(<\|im_start\|>|<\|im_end\|>|<think>|</think>)', full):
        if not p: continue
        if p in added: out.append(p)
        else:
            for m in pat.findall(p): out.extend(bpe_word(m))
    return out

import json, numpy as np
from utils import SafetensorsReader, rmsnorm, collect_tagged
reader = SafetensorsReader()
for L in [15, 19, 23]:
    in_norm = reader.get(f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.input_layernorm.weight")
    q_proj = reader.get(f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.q_proj.weight")
    k_proj = reader.get(f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.k_proj.weight")
    q_norm_w = reader.get(f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.q_norm.weight")
    k_norm_w = reader.get(f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.k_norm.weight")
    R, T, _ = collect_tagged(f"resid.{L}")
    R_hat = rmsnorm(R, in_norm)
    QG = (R_hat @ q_proj.T).reshape(-1, 8, 2, 256)
    Q_normed = rmsnorm(QG[:, :, 0, :], q_norm_w)
    K_normed = rmsnorm((R_hat @ k_proj.T).reshape(-1, 2, 256), k_norm_w)
    q_ans = Q_normed[T == "ANS_GUESS", :, 64:]
    q_mean = np.mean(q_ans, axis=0)
    q_cos = [np.mean((q_ans[:, h] @ q_mean[h]) / (np.linalg.norm(q_ans[:, h], axis=-1) * np.linalg.norm(q_mean[h]))) for h in range(8)]
    print(f"Layer {L} Q_nonrope cos consistency: {[round(float(c),3) for c in q_cos]}")
    for h in range(8):
        kvh = h // 4
        sg = float(np.mean((K_normed[T == "G_ENT", kvh, 64:] @ q_mean[h]) / 16.0))
        sq = float(np.mean((K_normed[T == "Q_PROMPT", kvh, 64:] @ q_mean[h]) / 16.0))
        st = float(np.mean((K_normed[T == "TEMPLATE", kvh, 64:] @ q_mean[h]) / 16.0))
        print(f"  L{L} H{h} (KV{kvh}): nonRoPE attn logit G_ENT={sg:+5.2f} | Q_PR={sq:+5.2f} | TMPL={st:+5.2f}")
